facts.text: offb_node subscribes the relative mavros/state topic with mavros_msgs::State and queue size 10.
offb_node includes the generated mavros_msgs/State header.
offb_node advertises geometry_msgs::PoseStamped on the relative mavros/setpoint_position/local topic with queue size 10.
offb_node includes the generated geometry_msgs/PoseStamped header.
offb_node declares a geometry_msgs::PoseStamped pose, sets only pose.pose.position.x, y and z, to 0, 0 and 2, and publishes that pose unchanged.
The offb node's comment states the setpoint publishing rate must be faster than 2 Hz and constructs ros::Rate(20.0).
offb_node publishes the pose 100 times, spinning and sleeping on the rate each time, under the comment 'send a few setpoints before starting'.
offb_node creates a mavros_msgs::CommandBool client on the relative mavros/cmd/arming name and a mavros_msgs::SetMode client on the relative mavros/set_mode name.

In its loop offb_node sends the custom_mode OFFBOARD request when the reported mode is not OFFBOARD and more than 5 s have passed since the last request, otherwise sends the arming request with value true when the vehicle is not armed and more than 5 s have passed, and publishes the pose on every cycle.
offb.launch includes px4's mavros_posix_sitl.launch and starts the offb node (type offb_node).
offb_velocity.launch includes px4's mavros_posix_sitl.launch and starts the offb_velocity node (type node).
Drone::Drone advertises mavros_msgs::PositionTarget on the relative mavros/setpoint_raw/local topic with queue size 10.
Drone::Drone creates a mavros_msgs::CommandTOL client on /mavros/cmd/takeoff.
Drone::Drone creates a mavros_msgs::SetMode client on the relative mavros/set_mode name.
Drone::Drone creates a mavros_msgs::CommandTOL client on /mavros/cmd/land.
Drone::Drone includes the generated mavros_msgs/PositionTarget header.
Drone::arm creates a mavros_msgs::CommandBool client on /mavros/cmd/arming, sets request.value to true and returns the response success flag.
Drone::setOffboardMode sets request.custom_mode to OFFBOARD and returns the response mode_sent flag.
Drone::land returns false without a call while home_set_ is false; otherwise it sends an empty mavros_msgs::CommandTOL request to the land client and returns the response success flag.

Drone::setOffboardVelocityBody sets coordinate_frame FRAME_BODY_NED and the type_mask IGNORE_PX, IGNORE_PY, IGNORE_PZ, IGNORE_AFX, IGNORE_AFY, IGNORE_AFZ, FORCE and IGNORE_YAW, sets velocity x, y and z and yaw_rate, and publishes the message count times with a rate_.sleep() after each.

Drone::setOffboardVelocityNED sets coordinate_frame FRAME_LOCAL_NED and the type_mask IGNORE_PX, IGNORE_PY, IGNORE_PZ, IGNORE_AFX, IGNORE_AFY, IGNORE_AFZ, FORCE and IGNORE_YAW_RATE, sets velocity x, y and z and yaw, and publishes the message count times with a rate_.sleep() after each.
The velocity example logs 'NED: Move towards South' before a setOffboardVelocityNED call with vy -2 and 'NED: Go Up' before one with vz 2.

The velocity example logs 'Body: Turn around yaw clockwise and climb' before a setOffboardVelocityBody call with vz 1 and yaw_rate -60, and 'Body: Turn yaw anti-clockwise' before one with yaw_rate 60.
Drone::toRadFromDeg returns deg / 180 * M_PI as a float.
Drone::getAltitude subscribes /mavros/altitude with mavros_msgs::Altitude and spins while altitude_received_ is false.
The drone_offboard header includes the generated mavros_msgs/Altitude header.
The velocity node arms, takes off, runs the NED and body velocity sequences and then calls land.
After the land service call the velocity node sleeps for five seconds, shuts ROS down and returns; it reads no landed state and sends no disarm request.
offb_node waits in a loop while current_state.connected is false before it sends setpoints.
Drone::getAltitudeCB stores the message and copies altitude_.amsl into altitude_in_amsl_.
drone_offboard.cpp includes the generated mavros_msgs/CommandBool and mavros_msgs/CommandTOL headers.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies with no PX4/Gazebo step or wall-clock pacing; placeholder state does not establish flight, trajectory or landing replay

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free recording fake for the MAVROS/PX4 SITL contract (no physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free ros_transport handler: it answers the declared MAVROS subscriptions and services and records the setpoint publications, but it runs no PX4 SITL, Gazebo, MAVROS, controller loop or wall-clock timer
state, altitude, setpoint effects and all service replies are placeholders; a live run needs the operator's MAVROS/PX4 graph and rosbridge endpoint
the fake snaps its placeholder AMSL altitude to the z of a published position setpoint so the resource changes; it integrates no motion and the publication receipt makes no arrival claim
a single rosbridge publication is not the clone's continuous 20 Hz or 10 Hz setpoint stream; MAVROS may reject an offboard setpoint that is not streamed

the fake starts armed in OFFBOARD at the offb hover altitude (2 m placeholder AMSL); its landing is a placeholder descent per sample and a disarm at touchdown (PX4's land detector and COM_DISARM_LAND live in the px4-firmware submodule, outside the citable clone), not PX4 or Gazebo

the e-stop is a sensed-confirmation stop (SAFE-049, simulated only): it sends /mavros/cmd/land and a /mavros/cmd/arming disarm request and is achieved only on three consecutive fresh samples of /mavros/state (connected, not armed) and /mavros/altitude (AMSL still) within the bound; the altitude bound is operator_required (a fake placeholder in fixtures/estop-confirmation.json) and the client bounds are fake-scale, so a live deployment sets both in simulation_deployment['estop_confirmation']

without PX4 auto-disarm the first e-stop stays unconfirmed (the disarm request is refused in the air) and the background retry's disarm after touchdown confirms it; a running offb_node requests OFFBOARD and arming again every 5 s and undoes a confirmed stop, which a reset's re-confirmation refuses but nothing prevents
MAVROS drives a real PX4 over a serial or network link with another fcu_url; this package is a simulated device only and that path is out of scope

the clone's offb.launch and offb_velocity.launch also start offb_node, which streams the (0, 0, 2) hover setpoint at 20 Hz and requests OFFBOARD and arming every 5 s, or the velocity node's own arm, takeoff, velocity and land sequence; with either node running the vehicle has competing commanders

velocity inputs are passed through with the clone's ROS-side signs (its examples log vz 2 as 'Go Up', vy -2 as 'Move towards South' and body yaw_rate -60 deg/s as clockwise); MAVROS's frame conversion is outside the clone and the driver performs none
the example site overlay values are operator examples, not device or flight-approval facts; without an overlay every numeric setpoint is refused
takeoff, the home-position topic, the trajectory packages, ROS parameters, QoS, namespaces, remapping and MAVLink framing are NOT COVERED

safe_state.description: Simulated only: landing requested and the vehicle sensed landed and disarmed: /mavros/state connected and not armed and /mavros/altitude AMSL still within the operator's bound, in three consecutive fresh stamped samples within the confirmation bound. The land response alone proves nothing; a running offb_node may re-arm the vehicle afterwards; nothing is claimed beyond the confirmation window.
